ordered_access_contract.order: Fresh status read, mask, ready test; only not-ready decrements (count-1)&255 and tests zero
ordered_access_contract.tx_ready: Zero-extend input low16, one SH16 at base+12, reset count=255 and base before RX polling
ordered_access_contract.rx_ready: Fresh LHU16 at base+12 then mask255
ordered_access_contract.tx_timeout: No data SH16 and no RX polling
ordered_access_contract.rx_timeout: One earlier data SH16, 255 not-ready RX status reads, no data LHU16
